pages.title: 英文法クエスト
pages.primary: Create an entirely original cover for a friendly illustrated English grammar learning book. Use the supplied leopard explorer only as the character appearance reference. Do not reuse the reference image's circular badge composition, Japanese map, castle, torii gate, globe, scrolls, armor, ship, or title treatment.

pages.title: 冒険の進め方
pages.mini: 最初に探す2つは？」 Answer: 「主語と動詞」 Reason: 「文の中心が先に見えるから。
pages.takeaway: 見る・読む・比べる・声に出すを1セットに！

pages.title: 英語の4つの地図
pages.mini: The small dog barked loudly.” 最初に残す骨組みは？ Answer: “The dog barked.” Reason: 「smallとloudlyは追加情報。
pages.takeaway: 全体の地図があると、長い文も迷わない

pages.title: 並び方で意味が決まる
pages.mini: The soup smells good.” is S＋V＋O or S＋V＋C? Answer: S＋V＋C. Reason: 「soup＝goodという説明。
pages.takeaway: 単語の意味＋置かれた席で、文を読む

pages.title: 文は4本のレールを走る
pages.mini: Emma sent Ken a message.” Which rail? Answer: S＋V＋人＋物. Reason: 「Kenにmessageが移る。
pages.takeaway: レールが分かれば、訳す前に構造が見える

pages.title: 前はしぼる　後ろは説明
pages.mini: In “The flowers are beautiful,” beautiful narrows or explains? Answer: explains. Reason: 「be動詞の後ろでflowersの状態を述べる。
pages.takeaway: 置き場所を見ると、情報の仕事がわかる

pages.title: 前に置いて、意味をしぼる
pages.mini: What does “almost ready” mean? Answer: 「もう少しで準備完了」. Reason: 「almostがreadyの程度をしぼる。
pages.takeaway: 前から、後ろの意味の範囲を決める

pages.title: 後ろへ、情報を足していく
pages.mini: In “The dog under the table is sleeping,” what does under the table explain? Answer: dog. Reason: 「名詞dogの直後から説明する。
pages.takeaway: 骨組みを言ってから、場所・時・特徴を足す

pages.title: 文の穴が、名詞を呼ぶ
pages.mini: In “the student who solved the puzzle,” where is the gap? Answer: before solved. Reason: 「studentがsolvedの主語。
pages.takeaway: 前の名詞と、後ろの空席を一本の線で結ぶ

pages.title: 置き場所で、役目が変わる
pages.mini: What is “water” in “Please water the plants”? Answer: verb. Reason: 「主語の後ろで動作を表す席。
pages.takeaway: 単語の仕事は、意味と配置の両方で見つける

pages.title: 並びを動かすと、気持ちが見える
pages.mini: Why is “Tomorrow, we begin the journey” fronted? Answer: 「tomorrowを先に舞台として示すため。
pages.takeaway: いつもの席から動いた語には、話し手の意図がある

pages.title: 声と並びで、気持ちを伝える
pages.mini: Turn “Leo opened the door.” into a question. Answer: “Did Leo open the door?” Reason: 「didが過去を担当し、openは原形。
pages.takeaway: 同じ内容でも、形と声で会話の役目が変わる

pages.title: 時は、カメラの距離で感じる
pages.mini: I am reading now.” is photo or video? Answer: video. Reason: 「進行中の動きを映す形。
pages.takeaway: いつ起きた？＋今どう見ている？を考える

pages.title: 過去形と現在完了を比べる
pages.mini: Choose “went / have been”: “I ___ to Canada three times.” Answer: have been. Reason: 「今までの経験回数。
pages.takeaway: 過去の日時なら過去形、今への関係なら現在完了

pages.title: 現在完了は、今への橋
pages.mini: I have known her for three years.” Which view? Answer: 「継続」. Reason: 「for three yearsが過去から今までの長さを示す。
pages.takeaway: 過去だけを語る形ではない。今に届く形！

pages.title: on は、接して支える
pages.primary: Independently teach the core spatial image of “on” as contact plus support, then show how that image extends to place, dependence, and attention. Source pages 41–43 are semantic coverage only. Do not reuse their examples, illustration, sequence, or wording.

pages.title: 文の骨組みへ出発！
pages.primary: Create an original, genuinely educational transition from the opening grammar map into sentence frameworks. Summarize how English meaning becomes word order, then preview the four functional parts. Source pages 44–47 are topic-sequence guidance only; copy no sentence, emblem, symbol, layout, or prose.

pages.title: 英文は、部品で組み立てる
pages.primary: Explain independently that many English sentences are built from a small set of functional parts. Source pages 48–49 provide grammar-topic coverage only; reproduce no wording, examples, diagrams, or layout.

pages.title: 意味から、文のレールを選ぶ
pages.primary: Independently show that a speaker first chooses the relationship to express, then places words on the matching sentence rail. Source pages 50–51 are grammar coverage only; create new wording, situations, examples, mechanism, and layout.

pages.title: 主語は、文の出発点
pages.primary: Independently explain the English subject as the starting point and topic placed before the predicate, including how to catch a long subject chunk. Source pages 52–53 are coverage only. Do not reuse their wording, examples, images, comparison, or page layout.

pages.title: 主語は、どんな形でもなれる
pages.primary: Independently teach that an English subject can be a noun phrase, an -ing phrase, a to-infinitive phrase, or a clause. Source pages 54–55 are topic coverage only. Never copy their wording, examples, figures, metaphors, sequence, or layout.

pages.title: “もの”を主語にすると近道
pages.primary: Independently explain that position makes a phrase act as a noun-like subject and that English naturally uses things, events, signs, roads, and causes as subjects to make compact sentences. Source pages 56–57 are coverage guidance only; reuse nothing expressive or visual.
pages.mini: ミニ問題：自然な英文はどっち？」 “A: This map shows the safest route.” “B: We can see the safest route when we look at this map.” 「答え：A」 「ものを主語にすると、意味を短く直接つなげられる。

pages.title: 動詞には、2つのチーム
pages.primary: Independently teach the two verb families: be as a connector between subject and description, and ordinary verbs as meaning-bearing action/state engines. Also preview their different question and negative mechanisms. Source pages 58–59 are coverage only; copy no wording, examples, figure, or arrangement.
pages.mini: ミニ問題：疑問文にしよう」 “Mia is ready.” 「答え：Is Mia ready?” 「be動詞 is を主語の前へ移す。

pages.title: 現在形は、主語を見て変身
pages.primary: Independently explain present-tense agreement: be changes among am/are/is, while ordinary verbs usually stay in the base form except third-person singular present. Source pages 60–61 are coverage guidance only; create all-new examples and visuals.
pages.mini: ミニ問題：正しい形を選ぼう」 “My sister (walk / walks) to the library.” 「答え：walks」 「my sister は I・you以外の1人で、現在の話だから。

pages.title: -s と was / were の合図
pages.primary: Independently teach how third-person singular present endings are spelled, and connect present be forms to past was/were. Source pages 62–63 are topic coverage only; do not copy their tables, word lists, prose, examples, figures, or layout.
pages.mini: ミニ問題：正しい形は？」 “Kai (watch / watches) the stars every night.” 「答え：watches」 「watch は -ch で終わるので -es。

pages.title: 過去の足あと、動く -ing
pages.primary: Independently explain regular and irregular past forms, then introduce -ing as a vivid moving form that can join a verb phrase, describe a noun, or act as a noun-like chunk. Source pages 64–65 are coverage only; make new wording, word choices, examples, diagrams, and layout.
pages.mini: ミニ問題：過去形にしよう」 “stop → ?” 「答え：stopped」 「短い母音＋子音で終わるので p を重ねて -ed。

pages.title: 変化形は、役目を変える
pages.primary: Independently teach key -ing spelling changes, the two central messages of the past participle (completion connection and passive result), and the value of learning basic verbs through a core image rather than a single translation. Source pages 66–67 are topic coverage only; do not reproduce their table, examples, metaphors, wording, or layout.
pages.mini: ミニ問題：-ing形にしよう」 “make → ?” 「答え：making」 「語尾の e を取って -ing。

pages.title: 動詞の力が、目的語へ届く
pages.primary: Independently explain the transitive sentence pattern as verb energy directly reaching one object, including noun-like object chunks and object pronouns. Source pages 68–69 are coverage only; create original prose, examples, mechanism, scene, and layout.
pages.mini: ミニ問題：目的語はどれ？」 “Mia opened the dusty chest.” 「答え：the dusty chest」 「opened の力が直接届く対象。

pages.title: 動作だけなら、自動型
pages.primary: Independently contrast three natural ways English names sports and activities, then connect this to the intransitive pattern where the verb has no direct object and modifiers merely add detail. Source pages 70–71 are topic coverage only; do not copy examples, sports lists, explanation, illustrations, or layout.
pages.mini: ミニ問題：自動型はどっち？」 “A: The bell rang loudly.” “B: The bell woke everyone.” 「答え：A」 「rang は動作だけで完結し、loudly は様子を足すだけ。

pages.title: 届く？つなぐ？説明する？
pages.primary: Independently distinguish direct-object impact from an intransitive verb plus preposition, then introduce the explanation pattern where the complement describes or identifies the subject. Source pages 72–73 are topic coverage only; do not reuse their sentences, figures, metaphors, wording, or page structure.
pages.mini: ミニ問題：どの型？」 “The soup smells delicious.” 「答え：説明型」 「delicious が the soup の状態を説明する。

pages.title: be動詞は、説明をつなぐ橋
pages.primary: Teach be as a lightweight connector between a subject and its description, while also showing common present-tense contractions and the freedom of the description slot. Source pages 74–75 are topic-coverage guidance only; invent every sentence, metaphor, illustration, question, and layout independently.
pages.mini: ミニ問題　空所に入る語は？」 “The map ___ on the desk.

pages.title: A＝Bに、動詞の色を重ねる
pages.primary: Explain that the subject-description pattern also works with meaningful linking verbs, whose own image overlaps A=B: change, continuation, and sensory impression. Source pages 76–77 guide coverage only; recreate nothing verbatim.
pages.mini: ミニ問題　意味に合う動詞は？」 “The soup ___ delicious.” choices “sounds / runs
pages.takeaway: まず A＝B。次に動詞のニュアンス！

pages.title: 文型が、意味のルートを作る
pages.primary: Bridge from remaining appearance/result linking verbs to the new double-object “giving” pattern, showing that sentence patterns contribute meaning. Source pages 78–79 are coverage guidance only; use wholly original wording, sentences, graphics, and order.
pages.mini: ミニ問題　語順を選ぼう」 “Mina showed (a photo / me) first.
pages.takeaway: 単語だけでなく、並びそのものにも意味がある

pages.title: 渡す型と to・for の分かれ道
pages.primary: Teach the double-object giving pattern for concrete, abstract, and negative transfer, then contrast it with to/for alternatives that spotlight the receiver or beneficiary. Source pages 80–81 guide topic coverage only; copy nothing.
pages.mini: ミニ問題　to / for？」 “Leo baked bread ___ his team.
pages.takeaway: to は届く先、for は受ける利益

pages.title: 動詞には、得意な文型がある
pages.primary: Explain verb–sentence-pattern compatibility, including verbs that work both without and with an object, plus the rise/raise and lie/lay contrasts. Source pages 82–83 are coverage guidance only; invent all teaching language, examples, graphics, and practice.
pages.mini: ミニ問題　正しい語は？」 “Please ___ the notebook here.” choices “lie / lay
pages.takeaway: 目的語があるかを見れば、動詞の役割が見える

pages.title: 日本語訳より、動詞の動きを見る
pages.primary: Show how a verb’s image and its sentence pattern work together: one verb can expand meaning, and similar Japanese translations may require different English patterns. Include look/see, arrive/reach, and discuss. Source pages 84–85 guide coverage only; copy no wording, examples, diagrams, or order.
pages.mini: ミニ問題　自然なのは？」 “Let’s discuss (the route / about the route).
pages.takeaway: 訳が同じでも、英語の動きは同じとは限らない

pages.title: 直接つかむ？ 前置詞でつなぐ？
pages.primary: Teach a compact set of verbs that take a direct object without a preposition versus verbs that normally connect to a person through a preposition. Base coverage on source pages 86–87 only, but create completely original prose, sentences, groupings, and visuals.
pages.mini: ミニ問題　余分な語を消そう」 “Ken approached to the counter.
pages.takeaway: 動詞ごとの“つながり方”を、文ごと覚える

pages.title: 目的語の後ろに、説明を足す
pages.primary: Teach the object-complement pattern as “verb acts on O, then a following expression describes O”, showing several complement forms and useful everyday applications. Source pages 88–89 guide coverage only; make every sentence and graphic original.
pages.mini: ミニ問題　O＝Cを探そう」 “Keep the window open.
pages.takeaway: 動詞で終わらず、目的語の様子まで伝えられる

pages.title: 見た場面を、そのまま文にする
pages.primary: Explain perception-verb object complements: direct experience uses “see/hear/feel + O + verb”, while a that-clause reports information; compare bare verb for the event as a whole and -ing for a scene in progress. Source pages 90–91 guide coverage only; copy nothing.
pages.mini: ミニ問題　進行中なら？」 “Mio watched the deer (run / running) by the river.
pages.takeaway: 直接の場面か、伝え聞いた情報かを分ける

pages.title: make・have・let の力加減
pages.primary: Contrast make, have, and let in object-complement patterns, and distinguish doing an action oneself from arranging for something to be done with “have + O + past participle”. Source pages 92–93 guide coverage only; all explanations, examples, scenes, questions, and layout must be original.
pages.mini: ミニ問題　自分で直した？ 頼んだ？」 “I had my watch fixed.
pages.takeaway: 同じ“させる”でも、働きかけ方が違う

pages.title: 4つの『させる』は力が違う
pages.mini: 『弟を説得して片づけてもらった』に合うのは？」 choices make / have / let / get. Answer: 「get — 説得して行動へ向かわせるから」.

pages.title: 目的語を、to の先へ向かわせる
pages.mini: Complete 「Mia told Leo ___ quietly.」 choices wait / to wait. Answer: 「to wait — Leo が待つ行動へ向かう」.

pages.title: 思った内容は、後ろの文で説明
pages.mini: Choose 「Leo said the train (is / was) late.」 Answer: 「was — 過去の said に時をそろえる基本形」.

pages.title: 内容は that・whether・wh で選ぶ
pages.mini: 『その店が開いているかどうか知らない』の入口は？」 choices that / whether. Answer: 「whether — 二択が残っているから」.

pages.title: 遠回し疑問は、語順を戻す
pages.mini: choose correct: 「Do you know where is Mia? / Do you know where Mia is?」 Answer: second — 「疑問の気持ちは Do you know にある」.

pages.title: 伝言は今、命令はまっすぐ
pages.mini: soften/direct meaning: 「___ the map carefully.」 Answer 「Check — 動詞原形で始める命令文」.

pages.title: 命令・禁止・誘いを使い分ける
pages.mini: 『今日は急がないでおこう』は？」 choices Don't rush / Let's not rush. Answer: 「Let's not rush — 一緒にしない提案」.

pages.title: 依頼は、何枚オブラートを重ねる？
pages.mini: stranger at a station—choose Can you help me? / Could you please help me? Answer: second — 「距離と please で配慮を重ねる」.

pages.title: There で、新しい登場人物を呼ぶ
pages.mini: choose 「There (is / are) three keys on the desk.」 Answer: 「are — 後ろの three keys に合わせる」.

pages.title: 既知の場所と、新登場を分ける
pages.mini: known Mia's location—choose 「There is Mia in the garden. / Mia is in the garden.」 Answer: second — 「すでに知っている人を普通に主語へ」.

pages.title: 動きの向きを見よう
pages.primary: Independently teach the direction and motion cores of go, come, run, and bring. Source pages 114–115 are coverage only; do not reuse wording, examples, images, explanation order, or layout.
pages.mini: ミニ確認：『今そっちへ行くよ』は go / come？」 「答え：come」 「相手のいる注目点へ近づくから。
pages.takeaway: 日本語訳より、“どちら向きか”で選ぼう

pages.title: 力と方向で動詞をつかむ
pages.primary: Independently explain carry, drive, leave, rise, and fall through force, focus, and vertical direction. Source pages 116–117 are topic coverage only; copy no wording, examples, figures, or layout.
pages.mini: ミニ確認：The news drove him crazy. の drive は？」 「答え：力で状態を変える」 「him を crazy へ強く押している。
pages.takeaway: 具体的な動きが、抽象的な意味にも伸びる

pages.title: 向きを変え、手に取り、置く
pages.primary: Independently teach turn, pass, take, and put as four reusable movement mechanisms. Source pages 118–119 provide coverage only; do not copy examples, metaphors, figures, wording, or layout.
pages.mini: ミニ確認：I took the train. の take は？」 「答え：選択」 「移動手段として電車を選び取る。
pages.takeaway: 短い動作の絵が、多くの使い方を生む

pages.title: 置く・得る・与える
pages.primary: Independently contrast put and set, then connect get and give as opposite-direction transfer verbs. Source pages 120–121 are coverage only; reproduce nothing from the source.
pages.mini: ミニ確認：It’s getting cold. の get は？」 「答え：変化」 「状態が cold へ動いている。
pages.takeaway: 物の移動と状態の変化を、矢印で感じよう

pages.title: 作る・持つ・許す・見る
pages.primary: Independently teach make, have, let, and look through their core mechanisms. Source pages 122–123 are coverage only; do not reuse source examples, prose, art, or structure.
pages.mini: ミニ確認：The joke made us happy. の make は？」 「答え：作り上げる」 「us＝happy という状態を生み出す。
pages.takeaway: 訳を並べず、動詞ごとの中心動作を覚える

pages.title: 見る・聞くは、動作か感覚か
pages.primary: Independently distinguish look, see, watch, listen, and hear by action versus reception and by degree of attention. Source pages 124–125 are coverage only; copy no wording, examples, diagrams, or layout.
pages.mini: ミニ確認：『音楽に耳を傾ける』は listen / hear？」 「答え：listen」 「意識して耳を向ける動作だから。
pages.takeaway: look・listen は動作、see・hear は感覚

pages.title: 感じる動詞・伝える動詞
pages.primary: Independently bridge sensory verbs and speaking verbs: taste/smell/feel can express either deliberate action or incoming sensation, while speak/talk/say/tell differ in communication focus. Source pages 126–127 are coverage only; do not reuse examples, prose, images, or layout.
pages.mini: ミニ確認：『その案について話し合おう』は speak / talk？」 「答え：talk」 「双方向のやり取りを表すから。
pages.takeaway: 同じ『話す・感じる』でも、意識の向きが違う

pages.title: 情報は、頭と心を旅する
pages.primary: Independently explain tell, ask, know, think, and believe as a flow from messages to requests, stored knowledge, thought, and deep conviction. Source pages 128–129 are coverage only; reuse no wording, examples, art, or layout.
pages.mini: ミニ確認：What do you think of this idea? は？」 「答え：印象を尋ねる」 「think of は、その対象についてどう思うか。
pages.takeaway: メッセージ・知識・思考・信念を分けて選ぶ

pages.title: want は、足りないから欲しい
pages.primary: Independently teach want as a felt lack and contrast it with the softer social choice would like. Source pages 130–131 are coverage only; do not reuse examples, source illustration, wording, or layout.
pages.mini: ミニ確認：店で丁寧に水を頼むなら？」 「答え：I’d like some water, please.」 「would like が直接的な欲求をやわらげる。
pages.takeaway: want は直接的、would like はやわらかい

pages.title: 名詞は、3つの目で見る
pages.primary: Independently introduce English nouns and the three decisions used to shape a noun phrase: countability, number, and context/determination. Source pages 132–133 are coverage only; do not reuse source examples, list, diagram, artwork, wording, or layout.
pages.mini: ミニ確認：I bought ___ notebook. 空所は？」 「答え：a」 「数えられる単数を初めて出すから。
pages.takeaway: 可算・数・文脈を決めると、名詞がくっきりする

pages.title: 名詞は3回しぼり込む
pages.mini: choose many/much in 「We don't get ___ snow here.」 Answer: much — snow is treated as amount.

pages.title: 名詞のかたちは、中心へ重ねる
pages.mini: arrange 「wooden / a / bridge」. Answer: 「a wooden bridge — 限定詞→形容詞→名詞」.

pages.title: まとまり全体は、数えない
pages.mini: choose 「an advice / a piece of advice」. Answer: latter — advice is an uncountable information mass.

pages.title: 形で見抜く 可算・不可算
pages.mini: There is too (many / much) traffic today.」 Answer: much — traffic is an uncountable flow.

pages.title: 数えられないものは、単位で数える
pages.mini: complete 「two ___ of information」 choices pieces / informations. Answer: pieces — information itself does not become plural.

pages.title: 同じ名詞でも、形を見れば変わる
pages.mini: There isn't enough (room / a room) in my bag.」 Answer: room — undivided space.

pages.title: 丸ごとか、材料になった姿か
pages.mini: dinner meat—choose 「We had a lamb / We had lamb.」 Answer: lamb — meat/material view.

pages.title: 物ではなく、見方を数える
pages.mini: choose article in 「Leo goes to (school / a school) every weekday.」 Answer: school — purpose is education.

pages.title: 種類・一品・一回なら数えられる
pages.mini: travel skill—choose 「She has experience / an experience in guiding tours.」 Answer: experience — accumulated ability.

pages.title: 形のある一例を切り出す
pages.mini: choose 「Learning needs patience / a patience.」 Answer: patience — abstract quality without an individual boundary.

pages.title: 複数形は、音と形で変わる
pages.mini: ミニ問題：複数形は？」 “library → ?” 「答え：libraries」 「子音字+yなので、yをiesに変える。
pages.takeaway: 規則の道と、覚える変身を分けて整理しよう

pages.title: 集団は、ひとつ？メンバー？
pages.mini: ミニ問題：正しいのは？」 “The police (is / are) nearby.” 「答え：are」 「police は警察官たちの集団を表す。
pages.takeaway: 形だけでなく、話し手の見方が一致を決める

pages.title: 数より、“ひとまとまり”を見る
pages.mini: ミニ問題：is / are？」 “Five hours (is / are) enough.” 「答え：is」 「5時間を1つの時間量としてまとめて見る。
pages.takeaway: 英文の数は、頭の中の包み方を映す

pages.title: 一般なら複数、1つなら目印
pages.mini: ミニ問題：一般の話なら？」 “I like (rabbit / rabbits).” 「答え：rabbits」 「種類全体は、裸の複数形で広く表す。
pages.takeaway: 単数は特別な1つ。だから前に目印を置く

pages.title: 限定詞なしは、輪郭なし
pages.mini: ミニ問題：ふだん飲む種類の話」 “I drink (tea / a tea) every morning.” 「答え：tea」 「飲み物の種類・材料として、輪郭を作らない。
pages.takeaway: 名詞の前のフィルターが、見え方を決める

pages.title: the は、同じ1つを指す
pages.mini: ミニ問題：2文目は？」 “I saw a fox. ___ fox disappeared.” 「答え：The」 「前の文に出た同じ1匹を指す。
pages.takeaway: the は、話し手と聞き手のスポットライトを重ねる

pages.title: 1つに決まる合図を探す

pages.mini: 昨日の旅行記：We rested under a tree that (gives / gave) plenty of shade.」 Answer: “gave”. Reason: 「過去の物語に組み込まれた説明だから。
pages.takeaway: 物語の箱が過去なら、付属する説明も自然に過去になる

pages.title: 短文から“流れ”のある英語へ
pages.primary: Create an accessible transition into combining sentences. Explain that knowing individual sentence patterns is the first stage; fluent English also needs relationships across ideas. Preview three tools: conjunction/linking, substitution to avoid repetition, and omission of recoverable material. This is a conceptual roadmap, not a full conjunction lesson.
pages.mini: 関係を明示：It started raining. We opened our umbrellas. → It started raining, (so / but) we opened our umbrellas.」 Answer: “so”. Reason: 「後ろが前の出来事の結果。
pages.takeaway: 文法的に正しい短文を、意味の関係で結んで流れにする

pages.chapterTitle: 文をつなぎ、会話を伝える

pages.chapterTitle: 文をつなぎ、会話を伝える

pages.chapterTitle: 文をつなぎ、会話を伝える

pages.title: 対比とwhenを一本の軸で読む

pages.title: 時間接続詞をタイムラインで整理
pages.chapterTitle: 文をつなぎ、会話を伝える

pages.chapterTitle: 文をつなぎ、会話を伝える

pages.title: 接続表現から“流れを整える”へ

pages.chapterTitle: 文をつなぎ、会話を伝える

pages.chapterTitle: 文をつなぎ、会話を伝える
